title: Lando Calrissian
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: As administrator of Cloud City, Lando Clarissian did his best to try to do right by his people and his friends. When the Empire showed up, led by Boba Fett and Darth Vader, Lando didn't have much of a choice when it came time to hand over his friend, Han Solo. As soon as the Empire turned their back on him, he sprang into action, doing his best to save his friend and join the Rebellion.
